answer: Each challenge is derived from a future drand quicknet pulse, whose threshold-BLS signature is unpredictable before release, then bound to the agent’s commit-reveal transcript. A vertex task may ask for a nadir path or a sparrow proof, but its nonce and verification target are fixed only after the pulse. This makes cached answers and advance offline farming ineffective; it raises the cost of sybil swarms without claiming to prevent automated attempts after the challenge is revealed.
